notes.title: Trading Cards (soon)
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! I'm thrilled to announce that the community items for [i]I Will Definitely Be the CEO![/i] are now officially live![/p][p]Starting today, Trading Cards will drop while you play. There are 12 cards in total, and each player can get up to 6 drops. You can trade these cards on Steam or use them to craft Badges. Badges come in five regular levels, plus a foil version (which requires foil trading cards to craft).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/cdd80a76a44a5b9712540ddaa066684e08e3c11e.png"][/img][/p][p]Each time you craft a badge, you'll also receive a random Emoticon and Profile Background. Emoticons can be used in Steam chat, and Profile Backgrounds can be set on your personal profile![/p][p]We want more players to enjoy our emoticons and backgrounds, so everything will be added to the Points Shop on October 1, 2025, where you can redeem them directly![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/81a5d3795be5f0b868e0881fe94301a342d7c3d0.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all for your love and support for [i]I Will Definitely Be the CEO![/i][/p]

notes.title: I Will Definitely Be the CEO! Is Available Now!
notes.content: [p]Live-action interactive drama "I Will Definitely Be the CEO!" is out now on Steam![/p][p]Launch day: 29 August, 10:00 AM (UTC+8) — grab it at 10 % off![/p][p][/p][p]Fresh out of college, you step straight into the corporate grinder.[/p][p]Your inbox fills with the usual poison:[/p][list][*][p]“You’re useless—if you leave this company you’re nothing!”[/p][/*][*][p]“996 is a blessing; be grateful, kid.”[/p][/*][*][p]“I yell at you because I believe in you!”[/p][/*][/list][p]Swallow it? Fight back? The choice is yours.[/p][p][/p][p]Shot entirely in first-person, the game drops you into an office that feels all too real. Lucky for you, a few colleagues are in your corner—some admire you, some might even like you.[/p][p][/p][p]With more than 10 endings, every decision counts. Stay put or climb higher—just make sure it’s the choice you can live with.[/p]

notes.title: ❤️‍🔥Live-Action Career-Reversal Game Launches August 29!
notes.content: [p]Produced by Xiaohuoyiba Film Studio and co-published by Liquid Meow Games, the live-action interactive workplace-revenge film-game [i]I Will Definitely Be the CEO![/i] is officially launching on August 29! This day also happens to be China’s traditional Qixi Festival! We look forward to celebrating with you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/b912b050f5ec043d11fec92576510c87b3abc228.png"][/img]In this career odyssey, you step into the shoes of Lin Ran—an exceptionally capable newcomer who keeps getting rejected at interviews. You’ll infiltrate “Youjia Tech,” the biggest game company in this fictional universe, and leverage your razor-sharp skills and a growing network of allies to claw your way up from the bottom. Outwit rivals, win hearts, and ultimately claim the CEO throne.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/9c799f9e41da3f006072810ff44510f7119b72e4.jpg"][/img]Settle for the safety of the bottom rung—or gamble everything to stand alone at the top?[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【Bargain with the tiger—or march straight into the jaws of death?】[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/12ff07a6979604ec30ee358dc13f22927da2fa7e.png"][/img]In [b]I Will Definitely Be the CEO![/b], landing a job is no smooth ride—it’s a gauntlet of chances and challenges. One misstep inside the company’s unspoken rules can cost you your livelihood; only a chain of smart choices will keep you alive and moving forward. Life rarely offers perfect solutions, so weighing gains against losses and trading value for security is the iron law of survival. Seize every opening that appears, keep the initiative in your own hands, and transform into a dragon in the corporate sea. Power, profit, affection, and prestige—none of them are out of reach if you play the game right.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【Navigate the shadow rules of the corporate jungle and claw your way up from the ground floor—one calculated move at a time】[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/6f9296c07542181b2a7cc61757eb0e13f4c81cb3.png"][/img]The protagonist moves only as you decide—you are the story’s beating heart. Inside the game, office realities like PUA, bullying, and cliques play out in unflinching detail. Cross the wrong line and you’ll slice into capital’s cake; can you still walk away clean from the trap they set? Every choice hurls you onto a new crossroads, and every crossroads births an entirely fresh tale.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【Multiple endings—every choice shapes your destiny】[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/4f929662f93a2fbe4ae45beefae306e83792c393.png"][/img]Built with sprawling chapters, branching paths, and a mosaic of endings, the game turns every decision into a new story waiting to be uncovered. Will you widen your “circle of friends” or become the lone wolf who silences dissent? Can you strip away the gilded veneer to expose the rust beneath? There may never be a “perfect” choice—but there will always be your truest one.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【Step into the real workplace in first person—never give up, not even for a second】[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/f24fea3b0e3f3c72d8445678fee312f8a6b1aafb.png"][/img]See it through your own eyes—step into the role and make choices that feel real. Experience a career where stakes aren’t just profit and survival, but human nature itself. Even when you hit rock-bottom, rally every resource around you, weigh every risk, and claw your way back up for the ultimate comeback.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]【Raw emotional resonance—where ambition collides with love, betrayal, and the unbreakable bonds of the workplace】[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540780/e132a23877f39b75e1c525ea197c12d369ec8414.png"][/img]Live the story, be the character—let every feeling pour out. Ride a life that twists and turns through the game’s heart. When workplace romance finally tastes sweet, can that sugar coat all the bitterness you swallowed before? On the scales of love and ambition, which side will you weight? The pain they gave you—pay it back, twice as hard.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Add us to your wishlist now—let’s tear down the old workplace together, starting with you in the CEO chair![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570340/CEO/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
